findings.quote: The northbound far side transit stop on Carlaw Avenue at Gerrard Street will be temporarily located to the south side of the intersection in front of 375 Carlaw Avenue.

As Gerrard Portal construction progresses (Stages 1A to 1C), temporary sidewalk closures will occur along Carlaw Avenue, between Gerrard Avenue and Langley Avenue for driveway modifications and temporary traffic signal installation.
At least one sidewalk will remain open at all times, with signed detours and controlled crossings at Gerrard Street East and the PXO at Langley Avenue.
